SECOND POPULATION IDENTIFIED, measured, do not start until slice 3 lands. Full analysis post-01M16V3JQ (see coordination).

The first population was private-constructor case classes -- types TRYING to be boundaries and defeated by Mirror.fromProduct. It cannot find a type with NO boundary, because there is no privacy to defeat.

Second population: a validator whose return type is its OWN argument type, on a type that is publicly constructible. Thirteen validators wear the signature; of the nine types I resolved, EIGHT are public case classes: TranscriptAtlas (core/transcript.scala:81), SurfaceAtlas (core/atlas.scala:159), LatePoolingRecipe (embed-core/identity.scala:186), SidecarManifest (features/sidecar.scala:44), FeatureDerivation (features/derivation.scala:147), InterviewSource (interview/atlas.scala:32), RecallGraph (recall/graph.scala:12), PromptPackageManifest (acquire/prompt.scala:51).

ClaimMeta is the CONTROL: same validator signature, not a defect, because slice 2 gave it a private constructor this morning. So the screen discriminates rather than flagging every validator, and it demonstrates the fix moves a type from the defective population to the safe one.

Four of the eight are in core and features. RecallGraph is filed separately as bd-01M16V1QAXR4JT1F174H2BTQT3.
